frequency_question: What proportion of major guided missile co-production or domestic manufacturing setup initiatives achieve operational status within 27 months under maximum resource prioritization?
membership_rule: Includes state-level programs aiming to establish indigenous assembly or component manufacturing of foreign high-tech cruise or ballistic missiles. Excludes simple license-buys or purely maintenance/repair depots that do not involve manufacturing or assembly lines.

cases.name: India-Russia BrahMos joint venture manufacturing facility setup
Turkey-US/European Joint Strike Missile/component setup efforts

coverage_note: 5 major documented cross-border missile industrialization cases; historical base rate is low due to severe physical, tooling, and supply chain lead times.
known_gaps: Classified bilateral programs between Western suppliers and Eastern European states are excluded due to lack of public data.
skeleton: Total complex defense technology transfer and greenfield defense manufacturing lines initiated under high urgency divided by those achieving full operational assembly within 27 months.
validity_reason: Defense manufacturing globalization and digital tooling advancements may accelerate these timelines slightly over the rest of the decade.
